name: 犬猫室内训练尿垫干爽款
description: 室内定点如厕，表层导流锁水、底层防漏护地板

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and diagram boards, warm off-white wall #F0EEE9 plus pale wood floor #E6DAC8 for in-room scenes, warm cream board #FBF3E4 for chart screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with fill card, gentle contact shadows only, one sweeping side light when surface texture must read
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale matte wood floor #E6DAC8 and neutral matte board #F6F1EA, no gloss, no reflections of the surroundings
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline weight plus short label lines, sparse copy carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and small numbered discs in bright orange #EE7623, no filled 3D badges
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and centering across the set; the sheet shown laid flat or as a neat stack with one unit fully unfolded; geometry never re-designed
noDrift: no invented numbers or seal text
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean hygienic pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, pale blue-grey edge banding #BBD7EC, warm off-white panel #F6F1EA and one bright orange accent #EE7623; neutral bright soft high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, fill card and gentle contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with sparse placeholder copy; thin single-weight line icons and small numbered discs in bright orange #EE7623; seamless white boards for packshots and diagrams, pale matte wood floor for in-room scenes; stable product scale, centering and unfolded-sheet geometry; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清整叠片数感与单片结构，赢下首次点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a very slight downward tilt, stack behind and one unfolded sheet in front
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}: a neat upright stack of the thin sheets behind one fully unfolded sheet laid flat in front of it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level with a very slight downward tilt so the fanned stack edges read clearly. Bright even high-key studio light from the front-left with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding both the stack and the flat sheet. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, pale blue-grey edge banding #BBD7EC on the sheet borders. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond an even margin. Square 1:1 crop, 2K, commercial ecommerce quality. Negative: no wordmark or brand lettering, no packaging art, no overlay text or numbering, no hands, no pet, no tinted gradient background, no cut-off stack edges, no merged or duplicated sheet layers, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 用真实居家定点如厕画面让养宠人代入，建立情感认同。
shots.camera: straight-on at the animal's eye level, candid lifestyle framing slightly off-centre
shots.lighting: soft window daylight from the left, 5500K, gentle paw shadow, no harsh speculars
shots.background: warm off-white wall #F0EEE9 above a pale matte wood floor #E6DAC8
shots.props: a plain wooden wall rack with a hanging rope toy and an undecorated stainless bowl, neither covering the sheet
shots.whitespace: generous empty wall across the upper half for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} laid flat on a pale matte wood floor #E6DAC8 in a bright minimal entry nook against a warm off-white wall #F0EEE9, a generic small dog standing squarely with all four paws on the sheet. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at the animal's eye level with a candid, slightly off-centre framing. Soft window daylight from the left, 5500K, a gentle shadow under the paws, no harsh speculars. Props: a plain wooden wall rack with a hanging rope toy and an undecorated stainless bowl at the right, neither covering the sheet. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, with generous empty wall space across the upper half for copy. Negative: no visible people or hands, no readable text or labels, no branded collar or tag, no named breed styling, no mess or stain in frame, no duplicated furniture, no floating paws without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 把地板渗液受损的具体麻烦摊开，制造解决问题紧迫感。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down, identical framing on both panels
shots.lighting: even high-key light from the upper left, matched shadow direction on both panels
shots.background: bare pale wood floor #E9DCC5 on both panels
shots.props: clear liquid only, no cleaning tools
shots.whitespace: none, the two panels fill the frame
shots.textZone: 两块面板底部各一行状态标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing and lighting, both photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto a bare pale wood floor #E9DCC5. Left panel: a clear liquid puddle spreading straight across the bare boards. Right panel: {product} laid flat catching the same liquid, its raised border edges holding it inside while the floor under the sheet stays visibly dry. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key light from the upper left with a matched shadow direction on both panels. Each panel carries one short label line in a neutral band reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no extra whitespace between panels. Negative: no fabricated statistics or percentages, no readable brand wording, no real person or animal face, no exaggerated flooding or damage, no mismatched camera angle between the two panels, no different lighting between the two panels.

shots.intent: 用分层构造剖视讲清防漏机制，解释产品为什么能做到。
shots.camera: isometric view from behind-above at a 45-degree angle, layers lifted apart in mid-air
shots.lighting: flat even studio light, soft layer-to-layer separation shadows only
shots.props: thin leader lines, small numbered discs and blank label blocks
shots.whitespace: generous clear margin around the exploded stack for copy
shots.textZone: 上部主标题带与每层一枚引线胶囊标签位，下方一排编号说明位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic construction screen: an exploded isometric diagram of {product}, its separate thin layers lifted apart in mid-air and held in register. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from behind-above at a 45-degree isometric angle so each layer surface and its embossed pattern read. Flat even studio light with soft separation shadows falling straight down between layers, on a seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Thin leader lines in bright orange #EE7623 run from small numbered discs to a short label reading 「{callout_1}」 beside one layer and 「{callout_2}」 beside another, and below the exploded stack sits a matching row of blank two-line label blocks. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous clear margin for copy. Negative: do not state layer counts, material percentages or thickness figures, no invented technical claims, no tiny unreadable text, no fur or skin in frame, no overlapping or collapsed layers, no perspective distortion of the sheet edges.

shots.intent: 以液体被压边兜住并迅速下渗的实证画面坐实防漏卖点。
shots.camera: very low angle skimming just above the surface, extreme close-up macro with shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: sweeping side light from the left revealing the quilted embossing, soft specular on the liquid
shots.background: pale wood floor #DFCFB4 with a solid bright orange #EE7623 band across the bottom
shots.props: one curved thin arrow pointing to the raised border
shots.whitespace: minimal, the surface texture is the subject
shots.textZone: 底部横向色带承载一行短句位与一枚引线箭头
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} on a pale wood floor #DFCFB4, tight zoom on the moment a droplet of clear liquid strikes the quilted top sheet and beads before drawing inward. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a very low angle skimming just above the surface with a macro lens and shallow depth of field, foreground embossing sharp and the far border edge falling soft. A sweeping side light from the left reveals the diamond embossing and the raised border, with one controlled soft highlight on the liquid. A solid bright orange #EE7623 band runs across the bottom carrying one short line reading 「{selling_point_1}」 plus a thin curved arrow pointing to the raised border. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no dyed or fluorescent liquid, no invented absorption volumes or timing figures, no pet or person in frame, no dense body text, no watermark, no duplicated droplet pattern in the background.

shots.intent: 帮买家按犬型挑规格，消除选错尺寸的下单顾虑。
shots.camera: flat straight-on view of a printed chart board, no perspective tilt
shots.lighting: even flat high-key light, no dramatic shadow on the board
shots.background: warm cream board #FBF3E4 with alternating column bands in pale grey #E7E3DD
shots.props: line-art dog silhouettes graduating in size and one small sheet thumbnail per row
shots.whitespace: even margin around the chart, empty gutters between label column and grid
shots.textZone: 顶部一行提问式标题位、行首两列标签位与各空白表格单元位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant-picker infographic on a warm cream board #FBF3E4: a printed-style chart panel photographed flat and straight-on with no perspective tilt. A row of thin single-weight line-art dog silhouettes graduating from small to large runs along the top, above a blank matrix grid with alternating column bands in pale grey #E7E3DD and cream. {product} appears once per row as a small flat sheet thumbnail with a pale blue-grey edge band #BBD7EC at the left of the grid. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left row labels and a headline ask short placeholder lines reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 while every value cell is left completely empty. The layout occupies 50-60% of the frame with even margins. Negative: no numbers, no units, no weights, no durations and no capacity values, no breed names, no fabricated size advice, no tick marks implying a recommendation, no tiny unreadable text, no inconsistent silhouette weights, no drop shadow on the board.

shots.displayName: 整叠内容空白凭证收口
shots.intent: 以整叠内容物与留空凭证框收口，降低决策风险感。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, flat lay
shots.lighting: even high-key flat light with a soft fill, delicate contact shadow at the stack base only
shots.props: empty rounded seal outlines and two blank indicator bars in bright orange #EE7623
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 30% for copy
shots.textZone: 下部一排空白印章框与两条留空指示条位，其上一行短句位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust close, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: a full neat stack of {product} with the top sheets fanned into a soft arc and one unfolded sheet squared beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat studio light with a soft fill and a delicate contact shadow at the stack base only, on a seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Along the lower third sits a row of empty rounded seal outlines plus two blank indicator bars drawn in thin bright orange #EE7623 strokes as proof placeholders, with one short line above them reading 「{selling_point_2}」. The contents occupy 35-40% of the frame, with generous negative space on the right 30% for copy. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, lab reports, ratings, counts, seals or awards, no text inside the seal outlines, no wordmark or packaging logo, no hands, no pet, no clutter, no duplicated sheets merging into one another, no floating stack without a contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 纯白底，整叠薄片竖堆、前方平铺展开一片带浅色压边；图2 白底信息图，单片平铺左上折角，右栏三枚细线图标加短句，底部一条橙色横带放两个规格词；图3 低机位近地板特写，液滴落在菱格压纹面上向心收拢，上下各一条橙色带并配引线箭头短句；图4 选码对照表信息图，顶部一行提问式标题，一排由小到大的犬只线稿，下方灰与米黄交替列带的矩阵表；图5 等距爆炸分层示意图，编号圆片引线指向各层，底下一排编号说明；图6 玄关实景，浅色地板与米白墙，一只长毛小狗四脚站在展开的垫片上，旁有木质挂架绳具与金属碗。品类判定依据：以图为准，产品为犬猫室内定点如厕用吸收垫片，属宠物用品下清洁耗材，故 L1 宠物用品、L2 清洁，未采用源平台类目的宽泛挂法。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与平台角标、全部英文卖点原句与规格词、选码表中的尺码/体重/小时数与犬种名、分层图的层数与材质说明文字、吸收量与片数等数值，均改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 占位或空白表格单元、空印章框、留空指示条；动物仅作泛指处理，不指向任何具体个体。
